en: Claude's interface is really user-friendly.
Let me still guide you through the core
ideas behind this interface. At the center

options, more complexity to our tasks with

The most important setting here though is
the selection of the model, the AI model
that should be used.
Sonnet is the balanced default model,
capable enough for most everyday cowork
tasks while staying reasonably fast.
Anthropic also offers Haiku as the fastest

capable model,

thinking.

the chats and the

here,

In the capabilities menu, We should activate
search and reference chats and generate
